RailgunTankIconIGJun26.png|'''Railgun Tank''' on its Admin Panel icon (5 June 2026 – Present). }} ==Skin Trivia== *The current version of the default skin is based on the [[wp:M1 Abrams#Variants_and_upgrades|AbramsX]], an American Tech Demonstration Tank, albeit with a railgun. *The original '''Railgun Tank''' design may have been based on the [[w:c:cnc:Railgun tank|Railgun Tank]] from ''Command and Conquer''. *The {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin is based on the original default skin, though it also bears a similar shape to the [[wp:PL-01|PL-01]] Polish Light Tank. *The Apocalyptic '''Railgun Tank''' was actually to the game as a unit in the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]]. **It was referred to as Tank3 and, despite being a skin for the '''Railgun Tank''', it had the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] statistics. **Although the unit would be unused, the Apocalyptic '''Railgun Tank''' model can be found in [[Wrecked Battlefield II]]. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The goggles worn by the humanoid inside the '''Railgun Tank''' are a re-textured version of the the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''10 July 2019''' -
